seo.description: Build a consistent social presence with a practical content plan and a voice that belongs to your business.

heading: Give people a reason to pay attention.
audience: Businesses posting without a clear plan

sections.title: Set the direction
sections.body: Clarify the audience, channels, and role social media plays in the business.

sections.title: Plan and create
sections.body: Develop an agreed content approach, creative formats, and review process.

sections.title: Publish and learn
sections.body: Use feedback and relevant performance measures to inform future content.

scopeNote: Your final deliverables, timeline, and any external costs are confirmed in a tailored proposal.

faqs.question: Which platforms do you support?
faqs.answer: We select platforms based on your audience and scope rather than assuming every channel needs the same content.

faqs.question: Who approves the content?
faqs.answer: We agree on an approval process before publishing work. Your team stays involved in brand and factual review.

faqs.question: Is advertising spend included?
faqs.answer: Paid media work and advertising spend, if needed, are specified separately in the proposal.
